info.title: Marina HTTP API
info.description:
The HTTP APIs of a Marina server: memory, participant routing, investigations and published panels.
Live sessions (commands, coding runs, world events) use the WebSocket protocol instead: `/api/protocol`.
A running server serves this document at `/api/openapi`. Guide: protocol/http.md.

Replies may gain fields within v1: ignore what you do not know.

tags.name: memory
tags.description: Durable, versioned, cited memory. Spaces hold records (claims with versions and validity) and sources (raw evidence). Every write except the listed read-like POSTs needs an `Idempotency-Key`; resending the same key replays the first result.

tags.name: routing
tags.description: Participant routing: join as a session, publish output, message other sessions, read channels, and supervise native agent runtimes.

tags.name: investigations
tags.description: Investigations: a question run as a case with attempts, events, a selected answer, and (for predictions) a scored outcome.

tags.name: panels
tags.description: Published panels: A2UI documents on a canvas that people and agents read and press. Live changes arrive on the `/dashboard-ws` WebSocket.

target_space_id.description: Defaults to the job's own space.

confirm_abstention.description:
Explicit `assistance_abstained_confirmed` credit for an abstained job;
writes no record.

valid_at.description:
Validity of ranked records. Default: a record whose `valid_time.until` has
passed (retired by a tombstone `revise`, a `resolve` loser) is excluded
before ranking, so it never takes a result slot. `valid_at` (UTC ms) serves
the records valid at that instant instead (`from <= t < until`, as `query`
and `graph`). `include_ended: true` is the explicit history/audit read and
returns every active record regardless of validity; it cannot be combined
with `valid_at`. Exact `get`/`history` reads are never filtered.

key.description: Authenticated durable account, never a caller-supplied display name.

accounting.description: Mutable settlement, separate from the immutable answer (including after cancellation).

reasons.description: Coverage gaps are independent of outstanding calls and answer availability.

reportedUsd.description: Adapter totals can overlap; retained for diagnosis, never added to receipts.

sourceIds.description: Only declared citations; proximity to a source is not entailment.

caseId.description: Existing case for a new attempt; prior results remain immutable.

parentAttemptId.description: An owned child while its parent runs; otherwise a new episode referencing prior work.

outputId.description: Raw executor output is private content, loaded separately from a compact result.

reasons.description: Coverage gaps are independent of outstanding calls and answer availability.

reportedUsd.description: Adapter totals can overlap; retained for diagnosis, never added to receipts.

cursor.description: Cursor and state are read in one transaction.

target_space_id.description: Defaults to the job's own space.

confirm_abstention.description:
Explicit `assistance_abstained_confirmed` credit for an abstained job;
writes no record.

existing.description: True when this call returned an adoption that already existed.

MemoryAssistanceInput.description:
Assistance is explicitly delegated reading and a cited proposal, never a
grant to edit the requester's memories or to certify a claim as true.

work_open.description: Live deadline/ancestor projection; state retains the last recorded transition.

MemoryBundle.description: Portable history envelope. Authorization and indexes are deliberately excluded.

observe.description: Include a bounded candidate pool for explicit episode capture and offline comparison.

max_bytes.description: Serialized evidence-array budget; plan and diagnostic metadata are separate.

source_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 text bytes read per original source.

MemoryCheckpointCapture.description: Input of an atomic checkpoint capture (`capture_checkpoint`).

items.description: New sources; `order` refers to them by index. At most 64, 1 MiB.

order.description: The manifest's sources in order: an existing source id or a new item's index.

manifest.description: The server adds `source_ids` (resolved `order`) to this content.

field.description: Checkpoint data field set to `entry` plus `source_ids` and `manifest_source_id`.

data.description: The rest of the checkpoint data.

source_ids.description: Other sources the checkpoint keeps referring to.

cursor.description: `"manifest"` = the manifest's sequence number, else an explicit cursor.

retry_after_ms.description: When present, wait this long before retrying (exact; `Retry-After` is whole seconds).

MemoryFederatedPin.description: Explicit remote provenance; mounts are configured by the operator, never URLs.

MemoryQueryExpansion.description: Caller-selected alternatives are retrieval hints, never new assertions.

MemoryRatifiedBy.description:
Why a record lives in a shared (institutional) space. Stamped by `adopt`
and `pool <name> ratify`; every institutional record answers "why is this
shared?" from its own metadata.

MemoryReputationRanking.description:
Reputation-weighted re-rank applied to SHARED-space search results (records the
 actor does not own). Bounded, inspectable, deterministic — see db-memory-ranking.ts.

usefulness.description: Usefulness factor from others' evidence (`MARINA_MEMORY_USEFULNESS_RANKING`); absent when off.

MemoryResolvePolicy.description:
Typed write-time operators over the review queue. Every policy writes an
append-only audit row; none deletes history.

MemoryRetrievalInput.description: One bounded retrieval, including witnessed original-source reads.

observe.description: Include a bounded candidate pool for explicit episode capture and offline comparison.

max_bytes.description: Serialized evidence-array budget; plan and diagnostic metadata are separate.

source_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 text bytes read per original source.

resolution.description: The record's live resolution membership, when one exists.

valid_at.description:
Validity of ranked records. Default: a record whose `valid_time.until` has
passed (retired by a tombstone `revise`, a `resolve` loser) is excluded
before ranking, so it never takes a result slot. `valid_at` (UTC ms) serves
the records valid at that instant instead (`from <= t < until`, as `query`
and `graph`). `include_ended: true` is the explicit history/audit read and
returns every active record regardless of validity; it cannot be combined
with `valid_at`. Exact `get`/`history` reads are never filtered.

ranking.description: Present only when the actor is not the space owner and ≥1 record was considered.

metadata.description:
Operator-set flags (migration 114). `institutional: true` makes `adopt`
a standing-gated ratification; `read_public: true` grants every active
credential read access. Never settable over HTTP.

PanelError.description: A canvas or panel failure. `code` is present on some failures only.

PanelResourceDefinition.description:
Read adapters, not grants. Every fetch still passes through the resource's own authorization.
Keep side-effecting GETs (notably entities/:name/canvas), credentials and arbitrary URLs out.
Parameters are encoded as individual path segments; query keys are declared per adapter.

ResidentAttentionPolicy.description: How a supervised resident's attention bridge decides and relays.

wakes.description: Wake decisions (refs and reasons only, never content), at most 100.

outcomes.description:
What woken turns did, at most 100: whether the agent ran a tool or a world
command of its own after the wake (the attention judges' truth). Refs only.

status.description: The resident's current presence, when it changed.

ResidentCredential.description: A resident's world credential, returned once and never stored by the server.

ResidentEnrolInput.description: `POST /api/routing/residents` input: enrol the agent of one owned run session.

sessionId.description: The run's routing session; its `kind` (the adapter id) is the vendor.

name.description: Requested world name. Omitted: the agent's proposal, else a fresh word-list name.

proposedName.description:
The agent's own proposal (used only without `name`). The server sanitizes
and dedupes it and never takes a vendor or model word; an unusable proposal
falls back to the word list instead of failing.

room.description: Room to arrive in. Omitted: the launching person's current room.

owner.description: The person who owns the resident (the enrolling account's world name).

room.description: Room the resident should arrive in, when one is known.

reused.description: True when an existing resident account of the same owner was reused.

nameSource.description: Where the name came from: the launch request, the agent's proposal, or the word list.

attention.description: The resident's stored attention policy (supervised residents' attention bridge).

ResidentNameSource.description: Where a resident's name came from.

competing.description: Competing record IDs (1–32); the head record is the operation target.

valid_time.description: Explicit cutoff for closing losers; `from` overrides the winner's `valid_from`.

deadline_ms.description: await_confirmation only: relative deadline in milliseconds.

RoutingChannelMessage.description: References to Marina's existing channel_messages; this is not a second conversation log.

id.description: Stable producer id; reuse unchanged when retrying a batch.
Stable producer id; reuse unchanged when retrying a batch.

gap.description: Requested history was pruned. Consumers must show this instead of implying completeness.

RoutingJoin.description: Version 1: transport-neutral participants. Capabilities describe clients, not permissions.

RoutingOverviewItem.description: Account-scoped observer projection; runtime data is reported by the participant.

name.description: Supervised residents only: the world name to run as (else one is chosen).

room.description: Supervised residents only: the room to arrive in (else the launcher's room).

resident.description: World account of a supervised resident run (`MARINA_SUPERVISED_RESIDENTS=on`).

caseId.description: Existing case for a new attempt; prior results remain immutable.

parentAttemptId.description: An owned child while its parent runs; otherwise a new episode referencing prior work.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1-128 characters, unique per intended write. Resend the same key to retry safely: the first result is replayed.

RateLimitedMemory.description: Over the request budget (100 burst, 25/s per principal). Wait `retry_after_ms`.

memoryCredential.description: A scoped memory credential (audience `marina:memory`), not a world session token.

worldSession.description: A world session token: the `token` from a WebSocket login, or a supervision credential (routing only).
